About Us - LifeSciKY Skip to content Apply Now Home About Us Lab Residency Education News & Events Contact Us Apply Now About Us Building Kentucky's Life Sciences Future Accelerating scientific discovery, entrepreneurship, workforce development, and economic growth across the Commonwealth. Connect With Us Who We Are Science. Innovation. Kentucky. LifeSciKY is Kentucky’s nonprofit life sciences innovation organization dedicated to helping researchers, entrepreneurs, and companies turn scientific discoveries into products and technologies that improve lives. We provide shared laboratory space, scientific equipment, strategic partnerships, workforce development programs, and statewide initiatives that help innovators launch companies, create jobs, strengthen Kentucky’s economy, and build healthier communities. $1.7M+ Shared Equipment Available on site, day one Our Mission To accelerate life sciences innovation by supporting entrepreneurs, advancing scientific research, promoting science communication, developing Kentucky’s workforce, and strengthening the Commonwealth’s economy. Our Vision To make Kentucky a nationally recognized destination where life sciences innovators choose to discover, build, and grow. What We Do Four pillars driving Kentucky forward Innovation Infrastructure Providing state-of-the-art laboratory space, shared scientific equipment, and research resources
